description: 8-week internship contributing to a full-stack healthcare SaaS platform. Worked on digitizing clinical workflows including electronic prescriptions, pharmacy fulfillment, appointment scheduling, and real-time doctor-patient messaging with role-based access control.

responsibilities: Developed electronic prescription features including QR code generation and versioned fulfillment tracking
Built pharmacy module components with inventory management and concurrency-safe dispensing logic
Implemented real-time doctor-patient messaging using WebSocket/STOMP
Contributed to appointment scheduling with doctor availability management
Worked with role-based access control for five distinct user roles
details.contributions: Owned the prescription and localization areas of the MedFlow MVP. Implemented QR-verified pharmacy workflows and contributed to the real-time messaging system.

description: 8-week internship where I built the AI Knowledge & HR Copilot — a full-stack pnpm monorepo combining a RAG-based knowledge base with structured HR workflows. Implemented a document embedding/vector-search pipeline, a two-layer hallucination-refusal system, CV extraction, and candidate scoring with role-based access control.

responsibilities: Designed and implemented the RAG-based knowledge base with document chunking and embedding pipeline
Built HNSW-indexed vector search with pgvector and cosine similarity
Implemented a two-layer hallucination-refusal system for reliable AI responses
Developed CV extraction pipeline using Gemini JSON-schema mode
Built onboarding checklists grounded in company documents
details.contributions: Built the AI Knowledge & HR Copilot from scratch as the primary backend engineer. Implemented the entire RAG pipeline, vector search, hallucination prevention, and HR workflow features.

description: Developed a Flutter mobile application with a web-based admin interface and integrated Firebase services for backend functionality and real-time features.

responsibilities: Developed cross-platform mobile application using Flutter
Built web-based admin dashboard for content and user management
Integrated Firebase services for authentication, database, and storage
Implemented real-time features using Firebase Cloud Firestore
details.contributions: Delivered the TravelTun mobile application and admin interface, integrating Firebase services for a complete tourism platform.
